observed_failure_from_coordinator.first_attempt: Build passed; deployment syncing_files until 600000ms timeout.

conclusion: A fresh full workflow run at the same reviewed commit is a supported bounded retry. No official requirement for a new commit SHA was found; recovery is not guaranteed.
recommendation: Confirm previous deployment and workflow are terminal and the selected branch still points to the reviewed SHA.
Use the existing workflow_dispatch for publish-site.yml once, creating a fresh run/artifact without modifying content. A full rerun is also documented to preserve the original SHA.
Compare returned artifact/deployment IDs and final status; if cancellation repeats, retain logs/request IDs and treat as unresolved Pages service issue rather than repeatedly creating commits.

sources.finding: Reruns are supported within30days and retain original GITHUB_SHA/GITHUB_REF; jobs omitted from partial rerun retain outputs.
workflow_dispatch supports a new manual run on a selected branch; workflow must exist on default branch.
Build version is GITHUB_SHA; workflowRun is GITHUB_RUN_ID.
Action locates artifact in current workflow run and submits artifact_id, pages_build_version and OIDC token to create deployment.
Cancelled is terminal status; timeout capped600000ms and timeout explicitly invokes cancellation.

inference_and_limits: Fresh artifact/run may avoid reusing a failed deployment context, but the official implementation does not document backend deduplication or guarantee a recovery.
Same SHA alone is not shown to cause cancellation.
